verdict.rationale: Mercury ships a CLI, an MCP server, and web and API surfaces, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry controls, analytics opt-out, or tracking disclosure for any of these surfaces. Revoking MCP access and scoping API tokens are access controls, not telemetry opt-outs, so they earn no credit.
